ft.title: MSSU - Admissions information for first-time students (minimum standards, test policy)

test_policy.notes: ACT is 'not required for admissions but may be requested when enrolling in classes to assist with placement'; MSSU has been test optional since August 2020 (CDS C8F).

requirements.notes: Own online application; $60 non-refundable international fee (must be paid before acceptance). Freshmen must meet one of: 2.25 cumulative GPA, top 50% of class, or ACT 21 / SAT 1060 (per the international guide). Needs passport photo page, transcripts (university work needs a credential evaluation), proof of finances for one year, and a health center screening. After getting a visa, a $3,000 enrollment deposit is required. CDS C13 shows a $30 fee (resident rate) and an Aug 1 priority date with no closing date for first-year domestic applicants. No faith or interview requirement found.

deadlines.label: International fall 2027 application deadline
deadlines.notes: Fall = June 1 on the international page; no year is printed, taken as fall 2027. An older MSSU catalog page gave July 1.

deadlines.label: International spring 2027 application deadline
deadlines.notes: Spring = November 1; no year printed, taken as spring 2027 entry. Summer = April 1.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Waived for freshmen who completed 3 or more years and graduated from a US high school; transfers from US colleges with English Comp I and II at C or higher. Applicants below the minimums can apply to the Intensive English Program. Students with a TOEFL writing score below 25 must take an on-campus placement exam.

english.notes: TOEFL writing below 25 means an extra placement exam. No new 1-6 scale minimum is published.

aid.notes: MOSO International Achievement Scholarship $5,500 for the first year (24 credit hours) for freshmen educated outside the US with 2.75 high school GPA and the English minimums (renewable up to 8 semesters with 2.75 college GPA); MOSO First-Year International Award $1,000 one-time (2.25 GPA); MOSO International Retention Scholarship $1,000 ($500 per semester) after 24 credits with 3.0 GPA. CDS H6: 99 nonresidents received non-need-based aid, average $7,899. No international need-based aid found.

sat.note: MSSU's admissions pages do not print a SAT code; look it up in the College Board code search.

act.note: MSSU's admissions pages do not print an ACT code; look it up at act.org.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed on the pages reviewed.
